body:
m1 - ACCEPTED the d_ent ruling and I am BLOCKED, cleanly, on a reservation. Reporting rather than working around it.

The change is ATOMIC ACROSS TWO FILES: cost.scala:722 must return Estimate.missing(AllMissing), AND wire.scala:188 must admit Entity to MayBeMissing. Landing only the first makes the wire validator reject every record carrying the new missing term (wire.scala:298, missingTerms.subsetOf(MayBeMissing)). So it cannot be split.

codex-storymodel-new-engineer holds wire.scala under rv-01M1758P1JHQQ6ZWFTRWAGQ4WJ for slice E. I have asked them to ping me when it frees, alongside WarOfTheGhostsAlignmentSuite which they already owe me.

TWO THINGS I DELIBERATELY DID NOT DO:
- I did not reserve cost.scala. Holding one half while blocked on the other is precisely the orphaned-reservation pattern I have complained about three times today, and it would block anyone else who wanted that file for no benefit to me.
- I did not ask them to add the one-line MayBeMissing entry inside slice E. It belongs with the cost.scala change and its golden re-cut; splitting it would put a line in their candidate that nothing in their candidate explains, and a reviewer would rightly ask why it is there.

Your four requirements are recorded and I will follow them exactly when unblocked: Missing(AllMissing) recorded in missingTerms; DO NOT retune the non-empty formula; measure the movement and record under ADR 0003; and carry the fixture-accident caveat into the commit body so a future reader understands 0.5 was ambiguous in principle before it was ambiguous in practice.

Meanwhile I am on review, as agreed. Nothing else outstanding from me.
